rows.en: The MSP and the MHPSS intervention pyramid
rows.ne: MSP र MHPSS हस्तक्षेप पिरामिड
rows.bt: MSP and the MHPSS intervention pyramid
rows.note: The recurring framework label 'intervention pyramid' is absent from G-0.1; a nonclinical terminology proposal is listed.

rows.section: The MSP and the MHPSS intervention pyramid
rows.en: In emergencies, people are affected in different ways and require different kinds of services and supports.
rows.ne: आपत्कालीन अवस्थामा मानिसहरू विभिन्न तरिकाले प्रभावित हुन्छन् र उनीहरूलाई विभिन्न किसिमका सेवा तथा सहयोग आवश्यक पर्छन्।
rows.bt: In emergency situations, people are affected in different ways and need different kinds of services and support.

rows.section: The MSP and the MHPSS intervention pyramid
rows.en: The concept of a layered intervention pyramid has frequently been used to illustrate the range of complementary supports that are required (see Figure 1).
rows.ne: आवश्यक पर्ने परिपूरक सहयोगको दायरा स्पष्ट पार्न तहगत हस्तक्षेप पिरामिडको अवधारणा बारम्बार प्रयोग गरिएको छ (चित्र 1 हेर्नुहोस्)।
rows.bt: The concept of a layered intervention pyramid has been used repeatedly to clarify the range of complementary support needed (see Figure 1).
rows.note: Uses the proposed nonclinical framework label 'intervention pyramid'.

rows.section: The MSP and the MHPSS intervention pyramid
rows.en: The most commonly referenced MHPSS pyramid is the IASC (2007) Intervention Pyramid for Mental Health and Psychosocial Support in Emergencies, although several versions have been published.
rows.ne: केही संस्करण प्रकाशित भएका भए पनि सबैभन्दा बढी सन्दर्भ दिइने MHPSS पिरामिड भनेको आपत्कालीन अवस्थामा मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक सहयोग सम्बन्धी IASC (2007) हस्तक्षेप पिरामिड हो।
rows.bt: Although some versions have been published, the most frequently referenced MHPSS pyramid is the IASC (2007) intervention pyramid on mental health and psychosocial support in emergencies.
rows.note: T001 is reused verbatim as an unreviewed candidate from PRIOR-SUM-29OCT2026 p.1 row 1. Uses the proposed nonclinical framework label 'intervention pyramid'. The source says several versions, whereas the Nepali and back-translation say many, increasing the stated quantity.

rows.section: The MSP and the MHPSS intervention pyramid
rows.en: The different versions of the IASC pyramid and other pyramid models of organizing MHPSS vary in how the layers have been labelled and activities categorized.1
rows.ne: IASC पिरामिडका विभिन्न संस्करण र MHPSS व्यवस्थित गर्ने अन्य पिरामिड ढाँचाहरूमा तहहरूलाई दिइएका नाम र गतिविधिहरूको वर्गीकरण फरक छन्।1
rows.bt: The names given to the layers and the classification of activities differ across the various versions of the IASC pyramid and other pyramid frameworks for organizing MHPSS.1
rows.note: The trailing 1 is retained as the source footnote marker.

rows.section: The MSP and the MHPSS intervention pyramid
rows.en: Notwithstanding these complexities, the various interpretations of the pyramid communicate a common set of underlying principles:
rows.ne: यी जटिलताका बाबजुद पिरामिडका विभिन्न व्याख्याले आधारभूत सिद्धान्तहरूको एउटै समूह प्रस्तुत गर्छन्:
rows.bt: Despite these complexities, the different interpretations of the pyramid present the same set of basic principles:

rows.section: The MSP and the MHPSS intervention pyramid
rows.en: ▶ A key to organizing mental health and psychosocial support is to develop a layered system of complementary supports that meet different needs.
rows.ne: ▶ मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक सहयोग व्यवस्थित गर्ने एउटा प्रमुख उपाय विभिन्न आवश्यकता पूरा गर्ने परिपूरक सहयोगको तहगत प्रणाली विकास गर्नु हो।
rows.bt: ▶ One major way of organizing mental health and psychosocial support is to develop a layered system of complementary support that meets different needs.
rows.note: T001 is reused verbatim as an unreviewed candidate from PRIOR-SUM-29OCT2026 p.1 row 1.

rows.section: The MSP and the MHPSS intervention pyramid
rows.en: ▶ All layers of the pyramid are important and should be made available concurrently.
rows.ne: ▶ पिरामिडका सबै तह महत्त्वपूर्ण छन् र तिनलाई एकै समयमा उपलब्ध गराउनु उचित हुन्छ।
rows.bt: ▶ All levels of the pyramid are important, and it is appropriate to make them available at the same time.
rows.note: The back-translation renders should as must, reflecting stronger obligation in the Nepali. The revision preserves a recommendation and concurrent availability. The back-translation weakens the recommendation that all layers should be made available concurrently to a statement that doing so is appropriate.

rows.section: The MSP and the MHPSS intervention pyramid
rows.en: ▶ There is a wide spectrum of MHPSS services and supports, with fewer people needing services at the higher layers of the pyramid, and a greater number of people needing services at the lower layers.
rows.ne: ▶ MHPSS सेवा तथा सहयोगको दायरा व्यापक छ; पिरामिडका माथिल्ला तहका सेवा आवश्यक पर्ने मानिसको सङ्ख्या कम हुन्छ भने तल्ला तहका सेवा आवश्यक पर्ने मानिसको सङ्ख्या बढी हुन्छ।
rows.bt: ▶ The range of MHPSS services and support is broad; the number of people needing services at the upper layers of the pyramid is smaller, while the number of people needing services at the lower layers is larger.

rows.section: The MSP and the MHPSS intervention pyramid
rows.en: ▶ Typically, delivering activities at higher layers of the pyramid requires more formal or specialized qualifications (education, health, social services etc.). This often corresponds to more training, supervision and mentoring being required for the staff involved.
rows.ne: ▶ सामान्यतया पिरामिडका माथिल्ला तहका गतिविधि सञ्चालन गर्न बढी औपचारिक वा विशेषज्ञतासम्बन्धी योग्यता आवश्यक पर्छ (शिक्षा, स्वास्थ्य, सामाजिक सेवा आदि)। यससँगै संलग्न कर्मचारीलाई प्रायः थप तालिम, सुपरिवेक्षण र मेन्टरिङ आवश्यक पर्छ।
rows.bt: ▶ Generally, conducting activities at the higher levels of the pyramid requires more formal or expertise-related qualifications (education, health, social services, etc.). Along with this, the staff involved often need additional training, supervision and mentoring.
rows.note: Mentoring is rendered as general guidance, losing the distinct staff-development activity. Accordingly also suggests a stronger consequential relationship than often corresponds to.

rows.section: The MSP and the MHPSS intervention pyramid
rows.en: ▶ The provision of MHPSS services and activities involves different actors; it is unlikely that any single actor can do this alone.
rows.ne: ▶ MHPSS सेवा तथा गतिविधि प्रदान गर्न विभिन्न पक्ष संलग्न हुन्छन्; कुनै एक पक्षले मात्र यो काम गर्न सक्ने सम्भावना कम हुन्छ।
rows.bt: ▶ Various actors are involved in providing MHPSS services and activities; it is unlikely that any one actor alone can do this work.

rows.section: The MSP and the MHPSS intervention pyramid
rows.en: ▶ The MHPSS response not only involves MHPSS providers; rather, a wide range of humanitarian actors across sectors play an important part (e.g. by ensuring that humanitarian aid is provided in a way that minimized psychological distress and promotes well-being, dignity and agency).
rows.ne: ▶ MHPSS प्रतिकार्यमा MHPSS प्रदान गर्नेहरू मात्र संलग्न हुँदैनन्; बरु विभिन्न क्षेत्रका धेरै किसिमका मानवीय कार्यमा संलग्न पक्षहरूले महत्त्वपूर्ण भूमिका खेल्छन् (उदाहरणका लागि, मानसिक व्यथा न्यून हुने र कल्याण, मर्यादा तथा आफ्ना निर्णय गर्ने र कार्य गर्ने क्षमतालाई प्रवर्द्धन गर्ने गरी मानवीय सहायता प्रदान गरिने कुरा सुनिश्चित गरेर)।
rows.bt: ▶ It is not only those who provide MHPSS who are involved in the MHPSS response; rather, many kinds of actors involved in humanitarian work from different sectors play important roles (for example, by ensuring that humanitarian assistance is provided in a way that minimizes mental distress and promotes well-being, dignity and the ability to make one's own decisions and act).
rows.note: The source uses past-tense “minimized” within a present-tense description; the draft renders this as the stated manner of providing aid.

rows.section: The MSP and the MHPSS intervention pyramid
rows.en: The pyramid model, in its various forms, can:
rows.ne: पिरामिड ढाँचाले आफ्ना विभिन्न स्वरूपमा निम्न कार्य गर्न सक्छ:
rows.bt: The pyramid framework, in its various forms, can do the following:

rows.section: The MSP and the MHPSS intervention pyramid
rows.en: ▶ Serve as a common framework for an integrated and holistic response to inform the programmatic and operational work of various humanitarian actors;
rows.ne: ▶ मानवीय कार्यमा संलग्न विभिन्न पक्षका कार्यक्रमसम्बन्धी तथा सञ्चालनसम्बन्धी कामलाई दिशा दिन एकीकृत र समग्र प्रतिकार्यका लागि साझा ढाँचाका रूपमा काम गर्न सक्छ।
rows.bt: ▶ It can serve as a common framework for an integrated and comprehensive response to guide the programmatic and operational work of various actors involved in humanitarian work.
rows.note: The recurring term 'humanitarian actors' is absent from G-0.1; a terminology proposal is listed.

rows.section: The MSP and the MHPSS intervention pyramid
rows.en: ▶ Be a helpful visual aid when communicating the multi-layered nature of MHPSS with various actors from different sectors/areas of work and when advocating to fill gaps in service provision;
rows.ne: ▶ विभिन्न क्षेत्र वा कार्यक्षेत्रका विभिन्न पक्षलाई MHPSS को बहुस्तरीय प्रकृतिबारे जानकारी दिँदा र सेवा प्रदान गर्ने कार्यमा रहेका कमी पूरा गर्न पैरवी गर्दा उपयोगी दृश्य सामग्रीका रूपमा काम गर्न सक्छ।
rows.bt: ▶ It can serve as useful visual material when informing different parties from various sectors or fields of work about the multilayered nature of MHPSS and when advocating to fill gaps in service provision.
rows.note: The source concerns gaps in service provision; the Nepali and back-translation shift this to service availability.

rows.section: The MSP and the MHPSS intervention pyramid
rows.en: ▶ Help different actors to understand where their activities fit in the MHPSS response, and inform their current and future programming.
rows.ne: ▶ विभिन्न पक्षलाई MHPSS प्रतिकार्यमा आफ्ना गतिविधि कहाँ पर्छन् भन्ने बुझ्न मद्दत गर्न र उनीहरूको वर्तमान तथा भावी कार्यक्रमसम्बन्धी कामलाई दिशा दिन सक्छ।
rows.bt: ▶ It can help different parties understand where their activities fit within the MHPSS response and guide their current and future programme-related work.
rows.note: The recurring term 'MHPSS response' is absent from G-0.1; a terminology proposal is listed. Programming is narrowed to programme formulation, excluding other current and future programme work.

rows.section: Illustrative examples of MSP activities in different layers
rows.en: Table 1 illustrates how MSP activities might be associated with different layers of the pyramid, and how this might vary depending on how the services are delivered.
rows.ne: तालिका 1 ले MSP गतिविधिहरू पिरामिडका विभिन्न तहसँग कसरी सम्बन्धित हुन सक्छन् र सेवा प्रदान गर्ने तरिकाअनुसार यो सम्बन्ध कसरी फरक पर्न सक्छ भन्ने देखाउँछ।
rows.bt: Table 1 shows how MSP activities can relate to different layers of the pyramid and how this relationship can differ according to the way services are provided.

rows.section: Illustrative examples of MSP activities in different layers
rows.en: It provides a specific illustrative example of how MSP activities may be mapped onto the pyramid (using the IASC 2011 pyramid as a base).2
rows.ne: यसले MSP गतिविधिहरूलाई पिरामिडका तहहरूसँग कसरी मिलाएर देखाउन सकिन्छ भन्ने एउटा विशिष्ट दृष्टान्तमूलक उदाहरण प्रस्तुत गर्छ (IASC 2011 पिरामिडलाई आधारका रूपमा प्रयोग गरेर)।2
rows.bt: It presents one specific illustrative example of how MSP activities can be shown aligned with the layers of the pyramid (using the IASC 2011 pyramid as a basis).2
rows.note: The trailing 2 is retained as the source footnote marker.

rows.section: Illustrative examples of MSP activities in different layers
rows.en: 1 For example, the top layer has been labelled ‘Specialized Services`, ‘Clinical Services’ or ‘Specialized Mental Health Care`.
rows.ne: 1 उदाहरणका लागि, सबैभन्दा माथिल्लो तहलाई ‘विशेषीकृत सेवाहरू’, ‘चिकित्सकीय सेवाहरू’ वा ‘विशेषीकृत मानसिक स्वास्थ्य हेरचाह’ भनिएको छ।
rows.bt: 1 For example, the topmost level has been called ‘specialized services’, ‘medical services’ or ‘specialized mental health care’.
rows.note: All three alternative layer labels are retained as labels rather than named therapies.

rows.section: Illustrative examples of MSP activities in different layers
rows.en: The third layer has been labelled ‘Focused non-specialized supports’; ‘Psychological Support’, ‘Focused (person-to-person) non-specialized support’, or ‘Focused Care’.
rows.ne: तेस्रो तहलाई ‘केन्द्रित गैर-विशेषीकृत सहयोग’, ‘मनोवैज्ञानिक सहयोग’, ‘केन्द्रित (व्यक्तिबाट व्यक्तिलाई दिइने) गैर-विशेषीकृत सहयोग’ वा ‘केन्द्रित हेरचाह’ भनिएको छ।
rows.bt: The third level has been called ‘focused non-specialized support’, ‘psychological support’, ‘focused (provided from person to person) non-specialized support’ or ‘focused care’.
rows.note: All four alternative labels and the person-to-person qualification are retained.

rows.section: Illustrative examples of MSP activities in different layers
rows.en: The pyramids also vary in terms of which activities they associate with each layer.
rows.ne: पिरामिडहरूमा प्रत्येक तहसँग सम्बन्धित मानिने गतिविधिहरू पनि फरक हुन्छन्।
rows.bt: The activities considered to be associated with each layer also differ across pyramids.

rows.section: Illustrative examples of MSP activities in different layers
rows.en: For example, basic psychosocial support, including psychological first aid, has been associated with different layers, including layer three and layer one.
rows.ne: उदाहरणका लागि, [psychological first aid] सहितको आधारभूत मनोसामाजिक सहयोगलाई तेस्रो तह र पहिलो तहलगायत विभिन्न तहहरूसँग जोडिएको छ।
rows.bt: For example, basic psychosocial support including [psychological first aid] has been linked to various levels, including the third level and the first level.
rows.note: The named intervention remains in exact source English; the sentence describes varying layer classifications rather than instructing its delivery.
